messages:
erin_support: FYI escalated from @josh.k — customer cust_9876 reports refund never posted. Autorouter invoked create_ticket instead of execute_refund. request_id=01-abc-789. pasting payload + logs below.
josh.k: Repro steps: POST /v1/support/actions with body from our integration queue. Happens when refund info ends up in nested meta. Payload:```json
{
  "customer_id": "cust_9876",
  "action": "refund",
  "meta": {
    "refund": "true",
    "refund_amount_cents": "5000"
  },
  "request_id": "01-abc-789"
}
```
mike.eng: Quick root cause guess: the dispatch classifier expects a numeric top-level amount (amount or amount_cents) to strongly prefer execute_refund. Here amount is a string inside meta -> weak signal, so fuzzy match picks create_ticket.
erin_support: Logs from the router decision: `decision_id=dec-7743` -> selected `create_ticket` (score=0.71) vs `execute_refund` (score=0.35). match_reasons: ["keyword:refund (ambiguous)", "no_top_level_amount", "meta.sentiment:urgent"].
mike.eng: Confirmed I can repro locally with that body. Minimal good payload that picks execute_refund: `{"customer_id":"cust_9876","amount_cents":5000,"intent":"refund"}`.
josh.k: Customer wants a fix today — can we hotpatch priority for execute_refund for this tenant? INC-4521 open.
mike.eng: Short-term plan: coerce common string flags -> boolean and bump refund-score when we see meta.refund in ["true","yes"]. I'll ship a 6h guard to the router scoring model (+0.4 to execute_refund) and add a metrics spike alert. Deploying now. :hammer_and_wrench:

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary router-config v2026.3.1 promoted for 6h -> https://console.redwood/internal/deploys/2026.3.1 :rocket:
erin_support: :thumbsup: I'll notify the customer and keep thread open for verification after deploy.

Notes / followups: - long-term: update schema validation on support endpoint to require top-level numeric amount for refund intents, and add a unit test for nested-meta shadowing. - add a synthetic test in CI that sends `meta.refund="true"` to ensure router doesn't misroute. :eyes:
